texts.value: Required for the maturation and transport of functional DUOX1 from the endoplasmic reticulum to the plasma membrane (PubMed:16651268). Recruits DUOX1 to the apical cell membrane (PubMed:39126279)

Heterotetramer with DUOX1 consisting of 2 DUOX1-DUOXA1 heterodimers (PubMed:33420071, PubMed:39126279). This may represent the inactive state (By similarity). Has also been detected as a heterodimer with DUOX1 which has been proposed to be the active state (By similarity). May interact with NUMB (PubMed:14670962)
Specifically expressed in thyroid gland. Also detected in esophagus
N-glycosylation of DUOXA1 is required for sorting of DUOX1 to the apical cell membrane
